description: Street signs (render-only). corners: one post per junction corner with street-name blades (name as signed, heading: compass bearing the blade lies along, in [0, pi)) and one-way signs (bearing the arrow points); inferred: placed from the road names where SFMTA lists no blade. curb: kerbside regulation signs on their block's sidewalk, heading = bearing along the street, kind: cleaning | permit | time | noParking | tow (generic faces; legends are not reproduced).
